entries.contract: 伪造/迟到ACTIVE报告不使托管Attempt或投影提前Running；报告关闭也不丢冻结名单；源状态和投影合法一致。
entries.observed: Strict BattleLog lookup binds explicit reports to the canonical Dedicated Attempt/projection and requires RUNNING/RUNNING or COMPLETED/COMPLETED; reports without strict identity remain standalone and do not infer old Meta rows. Integration coverage rejects a pre-running report without changing CONNECTING/RESERVED, accepts a completed late report without lifecycle mutation, keeps frozen roster identity separate from mutable player identity, and keeps standalone PvE non-official/retired records unchanged. No forged ACTIVE report plus closed-collector end-to-end run was executed, so AC-034 remains PARTIAL.

entries.observed: The allocator query requires READY, fresh heartbeat, non-revoked/non-expired credentials, native_admission_verified=true, exact locked game SHA, and strict-roster-v2. Heartbeat clears absent or legacy capability and forces RESERVED/RUNNING/CLEANUP_PENDING while an active assignment or cleanup lease exists. Current isolated tests exercise strict dedicated lifecycle, capability-v1 clearing, active assignment protection, and cleanup state, but do not run a live old/native_unverified registration plus real scheduler assignment; AC-045 therefore remains BLOCKED rather than PASS.
